files.summary: include role-inferred local identity repair in existing startup compatibility cleanup
edits: he same startup path calls `initializeIdentity` in `packages/domain/src/identity.ts`, which infers an absent local controlled/default-resident binding from controller metadata; fresh bundled-world construction also calls it. Separate legitimate authored creation from that retained-format repair. Preserve current account grants and human ownership outside gameplay rewind, and never derive shared-host authority from the local default binding ([identity contract](../identity-and-references.md#compatibility)). Trace creation and capability callers before replacing these shared initializers; a historical name or an optional field alone is not proof that every call is obsolete or that all otherwise supported input must be rejected
